mentions.name: gunicorn-prometheus-exporter
mentions.description: A Gunicorn worker plugin that exports Prometheus metrics for WSGI servers, monitoring worker performance including memory usage, CPU usage, request durations, and error tracking. Features Redis-based storage, YAML configuration support, advanced signal handling, and support for multiple worker types. It also provides request-level tracking, such as counts of requests to particular endpoints, for any WSGI-conformant framework like Flask or Django.
mentions.problem: Aims to replace Gunicorn's built-in instrumentation with richer metrics and extra information beyond what it currently provides.
mentions.source_excerpt: A comprehensive Prometheus metrics exporter for Gunicorn WSGI servers with support for multiple worker types and advanced monitoring capabilities, featuring innovative Redis-based storage, YAML configuration support, and advanced signal handling. This Gunicorn worker plugin exports Prometheus metrics to monitor worker performance, including memory usage, CPU usage, request durations, and error tracking
